name: Reassign Ownership on Termination
description: When an identity's lifecycle state becomes terminated, gives the roles, access profiles, entitlements, sources, apps, governance groups and identity profiles they own and their pending approvals and their open certifications to their manager, or the fallback owner when they have no active manager.

Get Departed Identity.description: Looks up the person who left, to find their manager. Nothing is changed here.

variables.name: newOwnerId
variables.description: Who gets the objects: the fallback owner unless a usable manager is found. Edit it here to change the fallback (an identity ID).

variables.name: ownerSource
variables.description: Why that owner: fallback or manager

Define Variable Owner.displayName: New owner: the fallback, until a manager is found
Define Variable Owner.description: Starts with the fallback owner as the new owner (reason: fallback). The manager replaces them below if usable. To change the fallback owner, edit newOwnerId here.

Has Manager?.description: Do they have a manager? Without one, everything goes to the fallback owner.

Get Manager.description: Looks up the manager, to check that they're still active.

Manager Inactive?.description: Has the manager left too (lifecycle state terminated or archived)? Then the fallback owner is used instead, so nothing ends up with someone who can't act on it.

Use Manager.description: The manager is usable: makes them the new owner (reason: manager).

Owner Usable?.description: Stops if the new owner would be the person who left (for example, they are the fallback owner) or the fallback owner was never filled in. Reassigning would then change nothing or fail.

Get New Owner.description: Looks up the new owner before anything changes. A governance group given an unknown owner loses its owner without an error, so the owner must exist first. An unknown ID stops the run here.

New Owner Found?.description: Continues only if the new owner exists.

New Owner Active?.description: Stops if the new owner has left too (lifecycle state terminated or archived): they couldn't act as owner.

Stop - No Usable Owner.description: Nothing was changed: the new owner would be the departed identity itself, the fallback owner ID was never filled in, or the fallback owner no longer exists or has left too. Set a fallback owner who is not leaving (Define Variable Owner → newOwnerId).

Get Owned Roles.displayName: Find roles the departed identity owns
Get Owned Roles.description: Lists the roles the person who left owns (up to 250).

Owns Roles.description: Do they own any roles? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Roles.displayName: Give each role to the new owner

Patch Role Owner.description: Sets this role's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Roles.description: Gives each of their roles to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Owned Access Profiles.displayName: Find access profiles the departed identity owns
Get Owned Access Profiles.description: Lists the access profiles the person who left owns (up to 250).

Owns Access Profiles.description: Do they own any access profiles? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Access Profiles.displayName: Give each access profile to the new owner

Patch Access Profile Owner.description: Sets this access profile's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Access Profiles.description: Gives each of their access profiles to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Owned Entitlements.displayName: Find entitlements the departed identity owns
Get Owned Entitlements.description: Lists the entitlements the person who left owns (up to 250).

Owns Entitlements.description: Do they own any entitlements? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Entitlements.displayName: Give each entitlement to the new owner

Patch Entitlement Owner.description: Sets this entitlement's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Entitlements.description: Gives each of their entitlements to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Owned Sources.displayName: Find sources the departed identity owns
Get Owned Sources.description: Lists the sources the person who left owns (up to 250).

Owns Sources.description: Do they own any sources? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Sources.displayName: Give each source to the new owner

Patch Source Owner.description: Sets this source's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Sources.description: Gives each of their sources to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Owned Apps.displayName: Find apps the departed identity owns
Get Owned Apps.description: Lists the apps the person who left owns (up to 250).

Owns Apps.description: Do they own any apps? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Apps.displayName: Give each app to the new owner

Patch App Owner.description: Sets this app's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Apps.description: Gives each of their apps to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Owned Governance Groups.displayName: Find governance groups (all; theirs are picked out next)
Get Owned Governance Groups.description: Lists the first 250 governance groups in the tenant. This list can't filter by owner, so theirs are picked out in the next step.

Owns Governance Groups.description: Do they own any governance groups? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Governance Groups.displayName: Give each governance group to the new owner

Patch Governance Group Owner.description: Sets this governance group's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Governance Groups.description: Gives each of their governance groups to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Owned Identity Profiles.displayName: Find identity profiles (all; theirs are picked out next)
Get Owned Identity Profiles.description: Lists the first 250 identity profiles in the tenant. This list can't filter by owner, so theirs are picked out in the next step.

Owns Identity Profiles.description: Do they own any identity profiles? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Identity Profiles.displayName: Give each identity profile to the new owner

Patch Identity Profile Owner.description: Sets this identity profile's owner to the new owner.

Reassign Identity Profiles.description: Gives each of their identity profiles to the new owner, in parallel (up to 250). A failed change affects only that one; the recheck at the end reports it.

Get Pending Approvals.displayName: Find the departed identity's pending approvals
Get Pending Approvals.description: Lists the approvals waiting for the person who left: access requests, forms and workflows (up to 250). It also returns approvals of governance groups they're in; those are left out next.

Has Pending Approvals?.description: Are any pending approvals assigned to them personally? Approvals assigned to a governance group stay with the group, so they're not counted.

Reassign Pending Approvals.displayName: Give each pending approval to the new owner

jsonRequestBody.comment: Reassigned automatically: the approver has left (workflow Reassign Ownership on Termination).

Reassign Approval.description: Reassigns this approval to the new owner.

Reassign Pending Approvals.description: Gives each of their own pending approvals to the new owner, with a comment. SailPoint records the reassignment in the approval's history.

Get Open Certifications.displayName: Find the departed identity's open certifications
Get Open Certifications.description: Lists the active, unfinished certifications they're the reviewer of (up to 250).

Has Open Certifications?.description: Do they review any open certification themselves? If not, the next step is skipped.

Reassign Open Certifications.displayName: Give each open certification to the new owner

jsonRequestBody.reason: Reassigned automatically: the reviewer has left (workflow Reassign Ownership on Termination).

Reassign Certification.description: Queues the move of this certification to the new owner.

Reassign Open Certifications.description: Moves each whole certification to the new owner through its campaign, with a reason, so the review isn't left with someone who has left.

Wait For Certifications.description: Waits a minute. SailPoint queues certification moves, and they still show under the person who left for a few seconds; checking straight away could report a false failure.

Recheck Roles.displayName: Recheck roles the departed identity owns
Recheck Roles.description: Checks that they no longer own any roles (a change can fail, or they owned more than 250).

Recheck Access Profiles.displayName: Recheck access profiles the departed identity owns
Recheck Access Profiles.description: Checks that they no longer own any access profiles (a change can fail, or they owned more than 250).

Recheck Entitlements.displayName: Recheck entitlements the departed identity owns
Recheck Entitlements.description: Checks that they no longer own any entitlements (a change can fail, or they owned more than 250).

Recheck Sources.displayName: Recheck sources the departed identity owns
Recheck Sources.description: Checks that they no longer own any sources (a change can fail, or they owned more than 250).

Recheck Apps.displayName: Recheck apps the departed identity owns
Recheck Apps.description: Checks that they no longer own any apps (a change can fail, or they owned more than 250).

Recheck Governance Groups.displayName: Recheck governance groups (all; theirs are picked out next)
Recheck Governance Groups.description: Checks again that none of the first 250 governance groups is still theirs.

Recheck Identity Profiles.displayName: Recheck identity profiles (all; theirs are picked out next)
Recheck Identity Profiles.description: Checks again that none of the first 250 identity profiles is still theirs.

Recheck Pending Approvals.displayName: Recheck the departed identity's pending approvals
Recheck Pending Approvals.description: Checks that no pending approval is still assigned to them personally (a reassignment can fail, or they had more than 250).

Recheck Open Certifications.displayName: Recheck the departed identity's open certifications
Recheck Open Certifications.description: Checks that they no longer review any open certification (a move can fail, or they had more than 250).

Anything Left?.description: Is anything still theirs? If so, the run ends as Failed (after the alert email, if set). Otherwise it ends as Done.

Stop - Ownership Not Fully Reassigned.description: The departed identity still owns some roles, access profiles, entitlements, sources, apps, governance groups, identity profiles or has pending approvals or has open certifications after the reassignment: a change failed, or they had more than 250 of one kind (for governance groups and identity profiles: theirs weren't among the first 250). Check this run's history, then run the workflow again or reassign the rest by hand.

Done.description: Everything they owned, and everything waiting for them, has a new owner.
